quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): operating revenue NT$20.926 billion, +9.4% from NT$19.122 billion, which the company attributes to customer expansion and product portfolio optimization; gross profit NT$10,865,082 thousand; operating income NT$2,907,571 thousand (+1.10%); net profit after tax NT$2.825 billion (+8.2%); EPS NT$17.32 vs NT$16.10. Wireless and wired communication chips were 99.95% of sales. 2025 sales by region: domestic NT$8,000,067 thousand (38.23%), Asia NT$12,239,883 thousand (58.49%), other NT$686,245 thousand (3.28%).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue NT$20.926 billion (+9.4%); EPS NT$17.32

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business structure (annual report): an IC design company in two fields. 'Wireline Infrastructure of Fixed Broadband Network' has three product lines: fixed-line broadband (GPON and 10G-PON), Ethernet (1G/2.5G/10 Gbps switch and PHY chips) and optical communications (50 Gbps and 100 Gbps PAM4-DSP and TIA chips for 8-channel optical modules of up to 800G, serving CSPs). 'Wireless Edge AI' has two: short-range wireless (Bluetooth audio and Bluetooth transmission) and satellite positioning (GNSS). The company names Qualcomm, Broadcom and Realtek as its main competitors.

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communications (annual report): Airoha supplies single-lane 50G PAM4-DSP chips supporting speeds up to 400G, serving multiple global cloud service providers; its single-lane 100G PAM4-DSP chip supporting up to 800G officially entered the tape-out stage in Q4 2025. Planned new products include 100G TIA chips for 400G/800Gbps data-center optical modules. The report's product history lists the 891x single-chip PAM4 DSPs for 50-400 Gbps data-center modules (2023), the 8968 single-channel 50 Gbps linear TIA for 200G/400G modules (2024) and the 8928 series single-channel 100 Gbps PAM4 DSPs for 400G/800G modules (2024).
quarterly_data.figure: single-lane 100G PAM4-DSP (up to 800G) taped out Q4 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fixed broadband and Ethernet (annual report): MediaTek's Wi-Fi 7 chips and Airoha's 10G-PON broadband chips have been adopted by multiple tier-one and tier-two global operators and entered mass production in 2025; in 2025 Airoha integrated XGS-PON and Wi-Fi 7 with European Tier-1 telecom operators and reached commercial mass production of its RDK-B GPON home gateway 7551 with a European Tier-1 operator. Ethernet focuses on 1G/2.5G PHY and cloud-managed 1G switch chips, combined with IC Plus Corp.'s power-over-Ethernet technology; the 10G PHY co-developed with Aeonsemi has commenced shipments; 2025 launches include the 8811 2.5G PCIe Ethernet chip and the 8858 8-port GE switch with 10 Gbps uplink (company: industry-first). Planned: a Wi-Fi 8 10G-PON home gateway SoC, 25G-PON and 50G-PON, a 50Gbps NRZ DSP for 50G-PON ONU optical modules, and new 10 gigabit NBASE-T PHY and switch chips.

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wireless Edge AI (annual report): the company claims a leading position in Bluetooth audio, tracking the Bluetooth 6.0 specification (12nm Bluetooth 6.0 AI audio chip 1595); in 2025 its hearing aid / assistive listening products launched with five of the world's top hearing aid brands as over-the-counter (OTC) hearing products; its BTD SoC with 8 kHz polling targets gaming HID. In satellite positioning it works with global brand customers in wearables and is developing low-earth-orbit satellite, fleet management, industrial and automotive markets. Planned: business and gaming wireless headphones, OTC hearing aids, wireless microphones and an AI/ML high-precision positioning SoC.

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing and suppliers (annual report): fabless; wafers are outsourced to foundries and packaging and testing to OSATs. Wafer supply status 'good and stable', with no supply shortage so far. Two unnamed wafer suppliers each exceed 30% of purchases: the largest (Company A) 43.77% of 2025 purchases (2024: 41.89%), Company B 37.15% (2024: 33.93%); total purchases NT$7,151,006 thousand (2024: NT$6,725,587 thousand), up on a recovery in market demand and more orders requiring more inventory.
quarterly_data.counterparty: undisclosed Company A and Company B (wafer suppliers)

quarterly_data.quarter: Airoha Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, people and facilities (annual report): 2025 R&D expenses NT$6,405,576 thousand, 30.61% of revenue (2024: NT$5,910,708 thousand, 30.91%); 1,330 R&D staff of 1,564 employees at end-2025; more than 900 patent applications and more than 580 patents granted worldwide. 2025 investing cash outflow NT$1,285,808 thousand, mainly intangible assets and property, plant and equipment; the office floors bought in the Tai Yuen Hi-Tech Industrial Park (board resolution of July 26, 2024) provide R&D office space and laboratories.
